identityScope: Exploratory probes hook the previously verified v9 compiled modules. They do not independently hash the complete runtime in every worker; exact candidate qualification is the separate v10 report. Prior source and seven JS/harness files are retained; the old compiled CLI bundles were not separately archived before rebuilding. Historical full-runtime reconstruction is not claimed.

phaseObservation.limits: Async-local attribution excludes setup/final reads outside recording. Inclusive timers overlap and change scheduling. Concurrent batch effects inherit the initiating async scope and are not a per-consumer CPU attribution. Cold summaries are five independent first/second-record observations.

experiments.scope: Scratch-only early bounded recording storage open concurrent with source preparation, inside the measured API call. Inspect writer freshly before opening; reuse same existing bounded pool, then ordinary recording still freshly inspects writer/bindings and integrity. Await early opening before API return. No artifact or event created by warm callback; existing bootstrap may perform layout/migration effects. Failure/authority/long-preparation timing semantics unqualified; not production or frozen qualification

Scratch-only read verification overlaps preparation recording. Prototype returns explicit recordingCompletion, never early recorded receipt; consumer awaits it and verification recording before result/measurement and drains in finally. All source/plan checks remain. Consumer await ordering changes inside timed work; diagnostic comparison, not unchanged frozen protocol. No native sync, source cache or IO/durability change. Effect and correction boundaries require independent production design; prototype does not authorize effects before receipts

decision: Reject speculative storage warming: no observed cold gain and warm/concurrent regressions. Read-overlap diagnostic reduces cold/warm means and justifies a bounded production observation lifecycle. Implement separate recorded receipt and read lifetime, isolated callback input, complete failure drains, original awaited API, output/effect boundaries and unchanged writer/CAS/integrity policy. Production qualification uses frozen v10 and does not inherit a diagnostic pass.
